data.description:
## Context
Session 7K1pS fixed the GoT relationships query to work with all entity types and all 29 edge types.

## Changes Made (commits a0e979c8, 33fab1ca, b45833b6)
1. Added _get_entity_node() for generic entity lookup (T-, S-, D-, EPIC-, H-)
2. Added converter methods for sprints, decisions, epics, handoffs
3. Rewrote get_all_relationships() to handle all edge types dynamically
4. Added grammatical conjugation for incoming edge names

## Validation Checklist
- [ ] Sprint relationships: `query "relationships S-027"` shows 8 contained tasks
- [ ] Task relationships: `query "relationships T-20251227-171020-2df0d769"` shows depends_on, depended_by, contained_by
- [ ] Handoff relationships: `query "relationships H-20251224-070920-ab3027eb"` shows transferred_by
- [ ] Decision relationships: Find a decision with edges and verify
- [ ] Epic relationships: Find an epic with edges and verify
- [ ] Edge types: Verify TRANSFERS, IMPLEMENTS, or other non-standard edges work
- [ ] Backward compat: Existing code using relationships still works
- [ ] GoT validate passes

## Knowledge Transfer
Read: samples/memories/2025-12-27-knowledge-transfer-got-relationships-fix.md

## Files Modified
- scripts/got_utils.py (lines 772-846, 1292-1456)

properties.retrospective: Validation complete. All entity types (T-, S-, D-, EPIC-, H-) and all edge types work with relationships query. Fixed missing get_decision() method in GoTManager (commit 1844972c). 337 unit tests pass.

data.title: Validate GoT relationships query fix for all entity and edge types
